cards.mood: The piece opens with a stark, ominous stillness that gradually accumulates weight and foreboding tension.
cards.palette: An acoustic guitar with a dark, woody tone provides the foundational rhythmic and harmonic pulse via a steady, percussive strumming pattern that persists from the first verse through to the outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
The iron frost bites the heavy ground
Silence hangs thick where the shadows are bound
A crown of ice sits on the throne
Where the seeds of winter were deeply sown
[Pre-Chorus]
The stars go dim in the grey
The light of summer fades away
[Chorus]
White death descends on the ancient land
Frozen by a cold and heavy hand
The kingdom sleeps in a crystal tomb
Wrapped in the weight of the winter's gloom
[Verse]
Breath turns to mist in the hollow air
The pines bow low in a ghostly prayer
Stone walls crack under the heavy weight
As the world bows down to a frozen fate
[Pre-Chorus]
The stars go dim in the grey
The light of summer fades away
[Chorus]
White death descends on the ancient land
Frozen by a cold and heavy hand
The kingdom sleeps in a crystal tomb
Wrapped in the weight of the winter's gloom
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The hearth fire dies to a steady spark
A frozen kingdom waits within the dark
[Chorus]
White death descends on the ancient land
Frozen by a cold and heavy hand
The kingdom sleeps in a crystal tomb
Wrapped in the weight of the winter's gloom
[Outro]
